description.full:
Black Mountain Activities — trading as Black Mountain Adventure — is an outdoor adventure centre established in 1992 and located at Three Cocks (Aberllynfi), near Brecon, Powys, within the Bannau Brycheiniog (Brecon Beacons) National Park.

The centre holds an active AALA (Activity Licensing Authority) licence (L161658, valid to June 2027) and is a British Canoeing Approved Centre and Archery GB Certified instructor. The company has won multiple awards including Best Adventure Centre in the Brecon Beacons at the Biz Growth Wales SME Welsh Enterprise Awards 2025.

Activities include gorge adventure, caving, rock climbing, abseiling, kayaking, canoeing, white water rafting, stand-up paddleboarding (standard and mega/giant SUP), improvised raft building, archery, clay pigeon shooting, high ropes, mountain biking, land carting, orienteering, boat hire, and guided walking and biking. The centre caters to individuals, families, stag and hen parties, corporate groups, school groups, and youth organisations.

The centre operates year-round and is within 2 hours of most of South Wales and the West Midlands.
